events.name: The Deserter of the Night's Watch
events.description: A Night's Watch deserter brings word of the White Walkers to the Stark family. Eddard Stark executes him, and Bran Stark witnesses the act — his first lesson in lordly duty.

events.name: The King Rides North
events.description: King Robert Baratheon arrives at Winterfell to offer Eddard Stark the position of Hand of the King. The Stark family is split between north and south.

events.name: Bran is Pushed from the Tower
events.description: Bran Stark witnesses Cersei and Jaime Lannister together, and Jaime pushes him from the window. The boy survives but loses the use of his legs — and a war is seeded in his mother's grief.

events.name: Eddard Discovers the Truth
events.description: Lord Stark uncovers that Joffrey Baratheon is not Robert's son. He confronts Cersei, who has him arrested and ultimately executed. The realm fractures.

events.name: Execution of Lord Eddard Stark
events.description: Before the Great Sept of Baelor, Eddard Stark confesses to treason he did not commit — and is executed by Ser Ilyn Payne. The shock reverberates across the Seven Kingdoms.

events.name: Daenerys Walks into the Fire
events.description: On the Dothraki Sea, Daenerys Targaryen places herself in the flames of her husband's funeral pyre. She emerges unharmed, cradling three newborn dragons — the first born in over a century.

events.name: Five Kings Lay Claim
events.description: Robb Stark, Stannis Baratheon, Renly Baratheon, Joffrey Baratheon, and Balon Greyjoy all claim the throne or independence. The Seven Kingdoms shatter into open war.

events.name: Death of Renly Baratheon
events.description: Renly Baratheon is murdered by a shadow creature born of Melisandre's power, taking with him the largest army in the field. His lords scatter to Stannis or home.

events.name: Battle of Blackwater
events.description: Stannis Baratheon's fleet is destroyed by wildfire in Blackwater Bay. Tyrion Lannister's tactical brilliance, Tywin's timely arrival, and the Tyrells save King's Landing — and Joffrey's reign.

events.name: Theon Seizes Winterfell
events.description: Theon Greyjoy captures Winterfell with a small force, executing Ser Rodrik and holding the castle until Bolton forces arrive to destroy it — and him.

events.name: The Brotherhood Without Banners
events.description: Beric Dondarrion and his brotherhood hold the Riverlands against all sides, resurrected repeatedly by the Lord of Light. Arya watches a man die and return six times.

events.name: Daenerys Liberates Astapor
events.description: Daenerys acquires the Unsullied by tricking the slavers — buying them with a dragon, then ordering the dragon to burn the owner who held the chain. Slaver's Bay trembles.

events.name: The Red Wedding
events.description: Robb Stark, his pregnant wife Talisa, and Catelyn Stark are massacred at the Twins by Walder Frey and Roose Bolton — the most catastrophic violation of guest right in living memory. The Young Wolf is dead.

events.name: Jon Infiltrates the Wildlings
events.description: Jon Snow spends months beyond the Wall with Mance Rayder's army, falling in love with Ygritte and learning the true scale of the Free Folk threat.

events.name: The Purple Wedding
events.description: King Joffrey Baratheon dies at his own wedding feast, poisoned mid-celebration. Cersei accuses Tyrion. The realm celebrates in private.

events.name: Trial by Combat — The Viper vs. The Mountain
events.description: Prince Oberyn Martell fights Ser Gregor Clegane as Tyrion's champion. He almost wins. The Mountain crushes his skull. Tyrion is sentenced to death.

events.name: The Battle of Castle Black
events.description: One hundred brothers of the Night's Watch hold Castle Black against Mance Rayder's hundred thousand wildlings. Jon Snow leads the defense through a night of desperate fighting.

events.name: Tyrion Kills Tywin
events.description: Tyrion, freed by Jaime and Varys, finds Shae in his father's bed. He strangles her. Then he finds Tywin on the privy and drives two crossbow bolts into him.

events.name: Hardhome
events.description: Jon Snow evacuates wildlings from Hardhome as the White Walkers attack. Thousands of the dead rise. Jon kills a White Walker with Longclaw — Valyrian steel destroys them. The Night King raises the fallen.

events.name: Cersei and the High Sparrow
events.description: Cersei arms the Faith Militant and is then arrested by them. Her walk of atonement through King's Landing — naked, jeered, pelted — is the realm's statement on the nature of power.

events.name: Murder of Jon Snow
events.description: Jon Snow is stabbed repeatedly by his own brothers of the Night's Watch — Olly last — in the courtyard of Castle Black. For the night, he is dead.

events.name: Daenerys Rides Drogon
events.description: Surrounded in the fighting pits of Meereen, Daenerys reaches out and Drogon descends. She rides him for the first time, into the sky and away from the burning arena.

events.name: Resurrection of Jon Snow
events.description: Melisandre performs a ritual over Jon Snow's body. Nothing happens. She leaves. Jon Snow gasps. He rises from the dead, remembering the cold, and nothing in the world is quite the same after.

events.name: Battle of the Bastards
events.description: Jon Snow and Ramsay Bolton clash before the walls of Winterfell. Ramsay's superior tactics nearly destroy Jon's forces before the Vale knights arrive. Ramsay is captured and fed to his own hounds.

events.name: The Destruction of the Great Sept
events.description: Cersei ignites caches of wildfire beneath the Great Sept of Baelor, killing the High Sparrow, Margaery Tyrell, Loras, Mace Tyrell, Kevan Lannister, and hundreds more in a single emerald explosion.

events.name: Arya Kills Walder Frey
events.description: Arya Stark, wearing another man's face, bakes Walder Frey's sons into a pie, serves it to him, then reveals herself and opens his throat with a kitchen knife. The North remembers.

events.name: Daenerys Arrives at Dragonstone
events.description: After a lifetime of exile, Daenerys Targaryen sets foot on Dragonstone — the castle of her birth. She touches the stone walls and walks the Painted Table where her ancestor once plotted the conquest of Westeros.

events.name: Battle of the Goldroad
events.description: Daenerys and Drogon attack the Lannister army's supply train returning from Highgarden. The Dothraki sweep. Drogon burns. Bronn wounds Drogon with a ballista. Jaime Lannister nearly dies.

events.name: Viserion Falls Beyond the Wall
events.description: Jon Snow's party is surrounded on a frozen lake beyond the Wall. The Night King hurls an ice spear. Viserion crashes through the ice, dead before he sinks.

events.name: The Wall Falls at Eastwatch
events.description: Viserion — resurrected, blue-eyed, breathing freezing death — destroys the Wall at Eastwatch-by-the-Sea. Eight thousand years of protection are undone in moments. The Long Night begins.

title: The Long Night & The Iron Throne

events.name: The Long Night — Battle of Winterfell
events.description: The armies of the living — Northmen, Unsullied, Dothraki, Free Folk, and dragons — meet the dead at Winterfell. The Dothraki flame goes out in an instant. Defeat seems certain until Arya Stark leaps from the dark.

events.name: Arya Kills the Night King
events.description: Arya Stark, applying everything Syrio Forel and the Faceless Men taught her, drops the catspaw dagger into her off hand mid-fall and drives it through the Night King's armor. He shatters. The dead fall.

events.name: The Burning of King's Landing
events.description: Daenerys Targaryen, grief-maddened and isolated, hears the bells of surrender and burns King's Landing anyway. Drogon scours the streets. Tens of thousands die. The Mother of Dragons becomes the Destroyer of Cities.

events.name: Death of Daenerys Targaryen
events.description: Jon Snow, knowing what she has become and what she will do next, embraces Daenerys in the throne room and drives his blade through her heart. Drogon melts the Iron Throne and flies east with her body.

events.name: Bran Stark Crowned King
events.description: The great lords of Westeros choose Bran Stark — the Three-Eyed Raven — as King of the Six Kingdoms, the first elected monarch in Westerosi history. Sansa secures the North's independence. The age of dragons is over.
